info.name: Dashy Chores API - Complete Test Suite
info.description:
Comprehensive test collection for the Chores API covering all endpoints, validation, edge cases, timezone handling, and error formats.

**Setup:**
1. Set base_url variable to your API host (e.g., https://api.dashy.local)
2. Run requests in folder order: Categories → Tags → Masters → Associations → Instances → Edge Cases
3. Use the 'GET /chores' response to capture generated IDs for subsequent requests

**Environment variables used:**
- base_url: API base URL
- category_id: Set after creating a category
- tag_id: Set after creating a tag
- master_id: Set after creating a master chore
- association_id: Set after creating an association
- instance_id: Set from GET /chores response
- member_id: Test member ID (e.g., faiyaz)
- member_id_2: Second test member ID (e.g., trisha)

exec: pm.test('Status 422 - name over 100 chars rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ master_ids: [pm.collectionVariables.get('master_id')], status: 'active' }) }
